title: Crossref XML deposit body v5.5.0
description: The body of a Crossref 5.5.0 deposit, as the commonmeta Crossref XML writer builds it before writing XML: elements as keys, attributes as '@' keys, text beside them as '#text'. Generated from the Crossref 5.5.0 XSD by scripts/crossref_json_schema.py; element order and the XSD 1.1 assertions are not checked, JATS and MathML content is not checked.
